MasulloTrace.spectral_tensor_cutoff_limit_of_summable.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (Classes K)] (μ : Measure (Classes K)) (φ : Classes K → ℂ) (hφ : φ 1 = 0)
  (S : Classes K → Classes K → ℂ) (w : Classes K → ℂ) (u v : ℕ → Classes K → ℂ) (hw : ∀ (x : Classes K), w x ≠ 0)
  (hu : ∀ (n : ℕ), MemLp (fun x => u n x / w x) 2 μ) (hv : ∀ (n : ℕ), MemLp (fun x => w x * v n x) 2 μ)
  (hsum : Summable fun n => ∫ (x : Classes K), ‖u n x * v n x‖ ∂μ)
  (hdiag : (fun x => S x x) =ᶠ[ae μ] fun x => ∑' (n : ℕ), u n x * v n x) (ρ : ℕ → Classes K → ℂ)
  (hρmeas : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEStronglyMeasurable (ρ n) μ) (hρbound : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (x : Classes K) ∂μ, ‖ρ n x‖ ≤ 1)
  (hρlim : ∀ᵐ (x : Classes K) ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => ρ n x) atTop (nhds 1)) :
  Integrable (fun x => S x x) μ ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ), Integrable (fun x => ρ n x * geometricKernel K φ S x x) μ) ∧
      ∫ (x : Classes K), geometricKernel K φ S x x ∂μ = -∑' (n : ℕ), ∫ (x : Classes K), u n x * v n x ∂μ ∧
        HasSum (fun n => ∫ (x : Classes K), u n x * v n x ∂μ) (∫ (x : Classes K), S x x ∂μ) ∧
          Tendsto (fun n => ∫ (x : Classes K), ρ n x * geometricKernel K φ S x x ∂μ) atTop
            (nhds (-∑' (n : ℕ), ∫ (x : Classes K), u n x * v n x ∂μ))

  (hρmeas : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEStronglyMeasurable (ρ n) μ) (hρbound : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (x : Classes K) ∂μ, ‖ρ n x‖ ≤ 1)

    Integrable (fun x => S x x) μ ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ), Integrable (fun x => ρ n x * geometricKernel K φ S x x) μ) ∧

MasulloTrace.weighted_convolution_adjoint_pairing.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (Classes K)] (μ : Measure (Classes K)) [SFinite μ] (φ f g W : Classes K → ℂ)
  (hW : ∀ (x : Classes K), W x ≠ 0)
  (hF : Integrable (fun p => star (convolutionKernel K φ p.1 p.2 * f p.2) * g p.1 * W p.1) (μ.prod μ)) :
  ∫ (x : Classes K), star (kernelConvolution K μ φ f x) * g x * W x ∂μ =
    ∫ (y : Classes K), (star (f y) * ∫ (x : Classes K), weightedAdjointKernel K φ W y x * g x ∂μ) * W y ∂μ
